current.text: Expert auction price is about 70 USD. Paying 85 USD means the extra 14 USD has to come out of other players' prices.
A safe pick at the top of the draft. Best case is 1st overall and the downside is around 5th. Experts rank him 2nd in 9-cat.
Possible second-round partners for him: LaMelo Ball, Stephen Curry, Alperen Sengun and Anthony Davis.
The Spurs manage his minutes. He will not play 35 minutes a night.
Fears about his durability are overblown. One shortened season came from a blood clot, and that is not expected to repeat.
Last season he led the league in blocks with 3.1 per game. That was a career low, because opponents stopped shooting near the rim against him.
Teams are expected to keep avoiding the rim against him. His blocks could fall below 3 per game or climb back to about 3.5.

durable.text: Elite shot blocker. About 50% of his rim contests turn into blocks. One expert calls him the best defender in the league.
His blocks are far above the player pool. His points and rebounds are league outliers too.
Turnovers are his one weak category. He is projected for about 2.8 per game, which is high for a center.
He helps in points, rebounds, threes, both percentages and blocks. The expert calls assists, threes and steals his weakest categories.
He does not win blocks on his own. A team still needs at least one other shot blocker.
He was one of the Spurs' best free throw shooters during the season.
He is still learning to score one-on-one, and it is not yet a strength of his game.
He has played about 65 games in two of his three seasons. One season was cut short by a blood clot.

note: He is a top-2 pick with a floor around 5th. That makes him a safe anchor, but last season our league paid 85 USD for him, well above the expert price of about 70 USD, the Yahoo average cost of 70 and the ESPN value of 65. Above about 75 USD, the extra cost comes out of the rest of the roster. He fits every build except one that needs to win turnovers, and he is an ideal core for punt TO. Still pair him with a second shot blocker. Early in the season, check whether his blocks climb back toward 3.5 and whether the Spurs cap his minutes near 30.
